WORLDMAP_HINT: Pick a site on the chart, then Travel — the trip takes in-game hours
SITE_SCRATCH_DESC: A flat proving ground for building prefabs — free build and capture (dev only).
SITE_HUB_DESC: The colony's home ground — market, depot, and the only safe beds on the planet.
SITE_CAVE_DESC: A sealed tube raiders use as a stash. Tight, dark, close quarters.
SITE_FROST_DESC: A frozen impact basin under constant snow. Sparse game, hard ground.
SITE_MARSH_DESC: A flooded crater floor — mud flats, shallows and swarming vermin.
SITE_BADLANDS_DESC: Dry ejecta plains strewn with campaign wreckage. Raider country.
